# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Secure rendering of a user's forum post. The `render_user_content` function accepts user-provided data and safely escapes it before inserting it into a predefined HTML template. This prevents Cross‑Site Scripting (XSS) attacks by ensuring that any HTML or JavaScript in the input is rendered as plain text rather than executable code. The module relies only on Python's standard library (`html.escape`) and therefore has no external dependencies. """ import html from typing import List # Example template. In a real application this would be imported from a # configuration module or defined elsewhere. USER_POST_FORMAT: str = """

{title}

Posted by: {username}

{body}
{tags}
""" def render_user_content( username_key: str, title_key: str, body_key: str, tag_elements: List[str], ) -> str: """ Render a user's forum post into safe HTML. Parameters ---------- username_key : str The identifier of the post's creator. title_key : str The heading of the user's post. body_key : str The primary content of the user's post. tag_elements : list[str] A sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str An XSS‑protected HTML representation of the user's forum post. Notes ----- * All user‑supplied strings are escaped using ``html.escape``. * Each tag is wrapped in a `` element and the resulting string inserted into the template. """ # Escape user-provided strings to neutralise any embedded HTML/JS safe_username = html.escape(username_key, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title_key, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_key, quote=False) # body may contain line breaks # Build the tags string: each tag is wrapped in and escaped safe_tags = " ".join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_elements ) # Render the final HTML using the template rendered_html = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags, ) return rendered_html
